earlier cart already far down track drifting outward while pole remains upright

counterfactual.change: changed initial.x from 0.4367 to 0.0 only; same steps/plant - cart no longer reaches track end, so failure removed

explanation: Controller regulates pole angle (theta ~0.08, margin ~0.72) but applies small positive force in same direction as cart velocity (~1.36 m/s outward), accelerating drift instead of braking/centering, so initial offset x=0.44 plus v=0.31 integrates to track exit at step 261.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart is positioned near the right end of the track with the pole remaining nearly upright and drifts further right from step 258 to 261. By step 261 the cart reaches the track limit without any visible centering or braking while pole balance is maintained.
